topic: Status of the proposed Montoir regasification expansion (as of mid-2026)
wiki_text: As of June 2026 the proposed Montoir-de-Bretagne regasification expansion (~2.5 bcm/y) remained without a final investment decision or firm commissioning date. The expansion was presumed shelved as of June 2022 when it dropped from Gas Infrastructure Europe's database, reappeared in the October 2022 ENTSOG TYNDP, and was still listed in the 2024 TYNDP published in June 2025. Elengy's terminal page describes Montoir's current 10 bcm/y send-out capacity and ongoing maintenance only; the principal active investment is the 'Ulysse' renovation/life-extension programme intended to keep the terminal operating until at least 2035, alongside a joint Elengy/GRTgaz call for interest in a CO2 liquefaction-and-export terminal at the site. The terminal's regas capacity is reported as fully booked from 2023 to 2035.

topic: Nature of the Fos Cavaou 'Expansion 2' capacity addition
wiki_text: Elengy/Fosmax LNG have publicly framed additional Fos Cavaou capacity as incremental: a first +1.5 bcm/y from 2024 via technical and regulatory debottlenecking and marginal investment, and a second +2.0 bcm/y that 'may be developed as of 2030', which would raise total receiving capacity to up to ~12 bcm/y through 2045 or beyond. Elengy's 2025-2026 'projects in the making' page lists no conventional regasification expansion at Fos Cavaou (only CO2, biogas and ammonia initiatives). GEM records the second addition as a separate 'Expansion 2' unit at 2 mtpa with status 'construction', based on the IGU World LNG Report 2025 construction table; the GEM researcher note flags that IGU construction-table entries are sometimes unreliable, and the unit/figure (mtpa vs bcm/y) and construction status warrant primary-source confirmation.
